title: Navigation: Link orphan pages in hub
desc: ModuleGrid lists 5 features but /incidents and /emergency pages exist and are not linked from hub.

title: Incident Reporting: Wire submit form and photo upload
desc: Submit Report button and form fields are uncontrolled with no handler. Add Photo Evidence is decorative only.

title: Incident Reporting: Wire detail view
desc: View Details buttons have no onClick, route, or GET-by-id API.

title: Incidents Dashboard: Wire Report Incident and fix schema mapping
desc: Report Incident button unwired. UI expects date/id/status Open|Investigating|Closed; API returns incidentDate/incidentNumber/REPORTED|INVESTIGATING|RESOLVED|CLOSED. Days Without Incident uses Math.random().

title: Incidents Dashboard: Wire emergency sidebar from API
desc: Sidebar emergency contacts hardcoded (911/EXT) instead of EmergencyService.

title: COVID Tracker: Add dedicated COVID API and wire daily check
desc: Page reuses HealthCheckupService with string filters. Submit Report for daily temperature/symptom check is unwired.

title: Health Checkups: Wire booking actions and fix schema mapping
desc: Book Appointment, Reschedule, Details, View Report unwired. UI expects type/date/doctor/clinic; API returns checkupType/scheduledFor/result/employeeId.

title: Emergency Contacts: Wire add contact and fix schema mapping
desc: Add Personal Contact unwired. UI filters type emergency/workplace/personal and uses contact.number; API uses FIRE|MEDICAL|SECURITY|UTILITY and phone.

title: Emergency Response: Wire SOS dispatch and geolocation
api: Missing alert dispatch and GPS/workplace API
desc: SOS countdown/alert is client-only simulation. Current location hardcoded as Office Location.

title: Safety Training: Add enrollment/progress model and wire course actions
desc: UI shows per-employee progress/deadline but API schema is catalog-only. Play course tiles and Download certification unwired.

title: Services: Wire orphan settings/analytics services
desc: HealthSafetySettingsService and HealthSafetyAnalyticsService defined but no page imports them. AnalyticsService.getMetrics() calls /settings instead of metrics endpoint.
